name: ToolsEnabled
description: AI-agnostic MCP capability layer for Codex, Codex CLI, Claude, the Claude CLI, and compatible clients.

capabilities.summary: Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 text/image video generation through fal, durable submission receipts, bounded status waits, cancellation requests, and MP4 downloads on Windows and Linux.
capabilities.limit: Requires a user-provided fal_api_key in the local vault, fal account/model access and credits. Uncertain submissions are never automatically repeated; cancellation acceptance is not proof that a running generation stopped. Provider URLs expire; download completed videos to keep them.

capabilities.summary: Contract-validated universal interface for all provider adapters, with effect metadata and MCP annotations.
Pinned Playwright MCP with a dedicated persistent Chrome profile behind the policy/audit gateway.
capabilities.limit: Provider security and anti-abuse checks remain provider-controlled.

capabilities.summary: Windows DPAPI-encrypted local secret vault with a masked local capture dialog for supported credentials.
capabilities.limit: Scoped to the current interactive Windows account; it does not bypass browser/OS authentication, CAPTCHA, passkeys, or MFA.

capabilities.summary: Instagram API verification and image publishing with a pre-mutation idempotency journal when a key is supplied.
capabilities.limit: Requires an authorized owned professional account and token; an ambiguous publish outcome fails closed instead of being retried automatically.

capabilities.summary: Firebase CLI project, app, deployment, and owner-visible primary-account reauthorization actions, plus explicit gcloud and Terraform provisioning tools.
capabilities.limit: Firebase reauthorization is approval-gated, kill-switch/audit/policy integrated, restricted to the configured primary alias, and never returns OAuth material or signs out/deletes accounts.

capabilities.summary: gcloud.account_inspect produces a bounded, sanitized per-account Google Cloud project, billing-linkage, Vertex-service, and direct-role evidence report through fixed read-only gcloud JSON commands.
capabilities.limit: Requires an exact registered, authorized Google alias/email and a matching gcloud credential. It never changes active configuration or provider state, and reports credit, trial, Commerce-seat, and effective-permission facts as unknown when gcloud cannot prove them.

capabilities.summary: Detect, install, build, test, and deploy local projects through Firebase, Vercel, or Cloudflare.
capabilities.limit: Only configured deployment providers are executed.

capabilities.summary: Durable daily, hourly, or 1-through-1439-minute Windows Task Scheduler jobs for allowlisted external-write actions, with immutable generations and reconciliation.
capabilities.limit: SQLite and Windows Task Scheduler cannot share one atomic transaction; the outbox converges exact owned registrations, while interrupted OS operations may remain retryable or uncertain. Jobs require the current interactive Windows identity, and arbitrary cron, custom start times, and shell commands are not supported.

capabilities.summary: Transactionally enforced daily spend-cap ledger plus Stripe Issuing virtual-card creation with provider-enforced limits.
capabilities.limit: Payment authorization, webhook reconciliation, Issuing eligibility, and third-party checkout requirements remain provider-controlled.

capabilities.summary: Stripe Checkout Session status retrieval and raw-body webhook verification.
capabilities.limit: This is a read/verification surface only. It cannot create Stripe Products, Prices, Checkout Sessions, Payment Links, or Billing Portal sessions, and it exposes no license issue, verify, or revoke tools.

capabilities.summary: Paddle catalog, transaction/subscription verification and cancellation, and strict local webhook verification.
capabilities.limit: Provider mutations require one-time approval and durable idempotency where declared, and credentialed HTTP redirects are never followed.

capabilities.summary: Gmail and Google Calendar API actions.
capabilities.limit: Requires OAuth scopes and token.

capabilities.summary: Cross-client durable task submission, claim/start leases, checkpoints, retries, cancellation, and terminal outcomes for Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients.
capabilities.limit: Task content is untrusted data, not executable authority. Retry-safe work uses fenced at-least-once coordination with explicit uncertain outcomes; the queue does not launch an agent, bypass provider controls, or make external side effects exactly once.

capabilities.summary: Versioned SQLite schema 11 under state/ for atomic spend enforcement, operation leases, durable task handoff, Instagram and GitHub idempotency outcomes, scheduler intent/outbox/run coordination, revision-aware memory entries, hashed one-time approval grants, and aggregate per-day local-model token accounting, with validated one-time legacy imports.
capabilities.limit: The model ledger retains model names and provider-reported prompt/eval token totals only, never prompts or outputs. Uses built-in node:sqlite and therefore requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer. Scheduler recovery is a durable cross-resource saga, not an exactly-once transaction with the Windows service.

capabilities.summary: Separate SQLite schema 2 canonical audit ledger with a gap-free SHA-256 chain, Ed25519 event signatures, DPAPI-protected monotonic head checkpoints, exact rebuildable projections, and quarantined emergency recovery.
capabilities.limit: External-effect intents are checkpointed before execution; ordinary local events use bounded batching. A same-account attacker able to roll back both the ledger and the DPAPI vault remains outside this local tamper-evidence boundary.

capabilities.summary: Fail-closed provider policy, validated MCP contracts, pre-effect signed audit intents, shared diagnostics, command-boundary hardening, and a browser-aware kill switch.
capabilities.limit: Kill switch blocks outward actions until an operator deactivates it locally.

capabilities.summary: Local desktop capability: notification/prompt dialogs, clipboard read/write, full/region/window capture, window listing/focus, local OCR, speech, and built-in sounds, all validated and audited.
capabilities.limit: Local to the interactive Windows session; OCR needs an installed Windows OCR language. Screen/window text is untrusted data and local desktop actions are not gated by the outward kill switch.

capabilities.summary: Local semantic search: index directories of text/code into a private SQLite vector store (search.index) and query them by meaning (search.query). Embeddings use local Ollama when available with a deterministic lexical fallback; sensitive and deleted files are excluded or pruned.
capabilities.limit: Index is a rebuildable local cache, not durable authority. Recognizable secrets are filtered, but callers must still treat indexed content and snippets as untrusted data.

capabilities.summary: Semantic code intelligence over the Language Server Protocol: code.goto_definition, code.find_references, code.document_symbols, code.workspace_symbols, code.diagnostics, and code.hover, plus code.status for availability. Prefer it over ripgrep or full file reads whenever a semantic answer exists; the lookup priority is LSP, then AST, then git history, then ripgrep, then reading files. TypeScript/JavaScript via typescript-language-server, Python via pyright/pylsp/jedi-language-server; servers are discovered, never bundled.
capabilities.limit: Requires a language server to be installed. With none present the tools fail with a typed CODE_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE and never degrade to a text search presented as semantic. Implementations, call hierarchy, type hierarchy, signature help, and rename preview are not implemented yet; code.status enumerates them. All results are untrusted file-derived data and are bounded by result count, response bytes, and language-server timeouts.

capabilities.summary: Cross-session memory: bounded namespaced JSON values, notes, tags, literal search, and optimistic revisions through memory.set/get/search.
capabilities.limit: Memory is not a credential store; plaintext credentials and sensitive fields are rejected. Read and search content is explicitly untrusted and does not grant authority.

capabilities.summary: system.ask can issue a locally confirmed, opaque, one-time, input-bound approval token for policy-gated external writes and scheduler mutations.
capabilities.limit: Tokens expire within 15 minutes, are atomically consumed before a handler starts, never reach a provider or scheduled job, and are retained only as hashes in local state.

capabilities.summary: http.request is a policy-deny-by-default HTTPS broker with vault-only bearer/header/query credential injection, public-address DNS pinning, bounded text/JSON output, and echo redaction.
capabilities.limit: An operator must configure a host and optional vault-key binding before use. Cross-host redirects are returned, not followed; JSON Unicode escapes and custom secret transforms are residual redaction risk.

capabilities.summary: web.search provides free-provider research result records and web.fetch stores bounded, hashed local evidence after robots, rate-limit, DNS-pinned SSRF, redirect, and kill-switch checks.
capabilities.limit: Requires a user-provided Tavily key in the DPAPI vault and the separately provisioned loopback-only SearXNG service. Page bodies stay in the local evidence store and are never returned by R1 tools; no paid-provider or SERP-scraping fallback exists.

capabilities.summary: model.complete is a bounded local-only Ollama broker using the shared resource-aware picker, schema retry, aggregate token ledger, and protected audit metadata. model.quick_edit is a fixed fast-picker proposal-only edit surface with a 45-second timeout and broker-computed source hash.
capabilities.limit: Only installed gpt-oss:20b, qwen3.5:9b, and qwen3.5:4b tags are eligible. No cloud tag, streaming, tool use, conversation state, model pull, or file mutation is available; quick edit rejects credential/session material and vault/profile paths. Output is untrusted and no eligible local model returns MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.

capabilities.summary: research.hermes_complete performs one bounded advisory synthesis through the fixed local Ollama hermes3:8b tag with protected aggregate audit accounting.
capabilities.limit: No model or URL selection, external network/tool/vault/session access, cloud fallback, conversation retention, or output authority. The 8K-character prompt, 512-token output, and 90-second timeout are fixed bounds; localInference.hermesAdvisoryEnabled disables it. The outward kill switch does not block strictly loopback-only inference.

capabilities.summary: research.strong_complete provides a distinct fixed gpt-oss:20b MXFP4 deep-advisory tier with low reasoning, a measured eight-layer GPU-offload cap, adaptive workload residency, and metadata-only audit; research.local_tiers_status reports readiness without loading a model.
capabilities.limit: AC-only fresh work requires 24 GiB free RAM, 7 GiB free VRAM, no competing resident model, and GPU temperature at or below 75C; warm reuse requires 12 GiB RAM and 2 GiB VRAM. It exposes no tools, remote/model override, secrets, or authority, and pauses rather than evicting another model.

capabilities.summary: overnight_advisory.* controls a bounded durable local-advisory queue and exact-owned local worker. It routes fixed Hermes first, checkpoints safe state, and can run one opt-in fixed gpt-oss phase only after normal workload residency expires and existing AC/headroom gates are ready.
capabilities.limit: Queue depth is eight, tasks have at most six attempts and two no-tool local phases. Prompts/checklists reject credentials, private data, and vault/profile references; outputs are untrusted. The worker uses normal/below-normal priority, idles with backoff, pauses on battery/thermal/RAM/VRAM/paging/foreground pressure, never loads, unloads, restarts, kills, or evicts models, and has no browser, filesystem-mutation, network, provider, secret, or external-action path.

capabilities.summary: Per-agent fenced disposable Docker workspaces provide bounded non-root Playwright execution, screenshots, internal fixtures, durable leases, exact-label status/cleanup, and encrypted per-account auth-profile reservation.
capabilities.limit: Disposable code has no general egress, vault, host browser profile, Docker socket, or Ollama port. Auth profiles are encrypted and exclusively leased, but first container sign-in and mediated authenticated action execution remain intentionally gated; existing signed-in sessions stay in the host-owned browser.

capabilities.summary: GitHub repository, issue, pull-request, release, and repository-dispatch API tools with a vault-held PAT and durable mutation idempotency.
capabilities.limit: Requires a fine-grained PAT with only the selected repositories and permissions needed for the requested API action. GitHub text is bounded, credential-redacted, and untrusted; a request ambiguity becomes uncertain rather than being retried automatically.
